NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Follower tracker
patches.description: Captures follower and following lists as you scroll them and sends them to your self-hosted tracker, which records who joined and who left, and when. Uses only the requests the app already makes. Apply alongside Piko.

options.title: Tracker token
options.description: INSTA_RELAY_TOKEN from the server's .env, sent as a Bearer token. Leave blank to keep it out of the APK - uploads queue until it is set.

options.title: Scroll lists automatically
options.description: Walk a follower or following list to its end by itself once you open it. Paced deliberately, and stops as soon as you touch the screen.
